inherited_source_checks.benchmark: Genesis 1–11: all 299 existing verse units aligned with the accepted rendering in Bespoke Saints English (1).pdf. This is exact benchmark alignment, not a newly established critical text.

checks.scope: Blessed/tribes, seed and soul, calves/mules, Sara spelling and Lot in 12:20.
Sand, east/sea directions and kinship wording.
Horses in 14:11,16,21; loaves in 14:18; created in 14:19,22; future hand clause in 14:22; 318 and named kings.
15:2 difficult household names; 11 sat down; 12 trance; 16 sins; 17 furnace and torches; 18 future grant and listed peoples.
16:2 singular address; 5 first-person seeing; 12 wild man and hands; 13–14 seeing expressions remain provisional.
Repeated adverb in 17:6; address number in 10–13; eighth day in 14; Sara/Sarah transition in 15; him in 16; nations in 20.
Address number in 3–5, speakers in 9–14, knew in 19, difficult passive in 21 and intercession numbers/repetitions.
19:14 daughters; 16 plural troubled; 18–19 singular petition; 21 face; repeated Lord in 24; Amman in 38.
20:3 death warning; 5 righteousness of hands; 13 future righteousness statement; 14–16 money, face and women; 18 womb wording.
21:7 nursing and old age; 9 playing; 14 shoulder wording; 16 child crying; 19 living water; 22 Ahuzzath; 30 future take; 33 field.
Beloved, high land, sheep, bound feet, knife/slaughter, 22:13 sabek, 14 seeing name, 17 cities and 21–24 names.
Two residence terms, king from God, double cave, four hundred didrachms, land/trees/borders and acquisition statements.
Prayer and its retelling, singular/plural address, earrings/weights, speaking in mind, plural brothers, possessions and mother’s house; both narrative accounts retained.
Names and ages; greater/lesser in 25:23; aplastos and singular house in 27. The English lexical choice remains provisional.
26:1–6 and 12–35, especially barley, farmland, living water, the negative at 32 and Hivite at 34.
27:1–28 and 39–40; blessing images and unresolved richness/cast-down syntax.
My God, sand, Oulamlous, vow syntax and direct address in 28:22.
Harran, repeated mother’s brother, weak eyes, marriage periods and hated.
Naming speeches, unmarked/marked in 30:42 and doubled exceedingly in 43. The latter repetition was explicitly restored to the English. Divination/botany remain for review.
31:7 ten lambs; 41 ten ewe lambs; 48–54 oath, heap and numbering, including no separate verse 51.
32:10–17 prayer, embedded divine quotation and animal counts; 23–31 wrestling, numbness and Form of God.
33:17–20 houses/booths, Salem, hundred lambs and altar naming.
34:1–4,12–18,25,29–31: Horite, violation, negotiations, named brothers, daughters and household.
35:4–6 and 16–25: difficult destruction clause, tower, Rachel’s death, Reuben and existing numbering.
36:24 Iamin/Onas; 27 four sons; 39 Arad son of Barad and Matred as son. Names not independently collated across witnesses.
37:28 twenty gold pieces and selling sequence; 35 Hades; 36 court titles.
38:2 Shua; 12 Hirah as shepherd; 25–26 pledges, recognition and comparison.
39:1 court titles; 14 and 17 different reported accusations; 20 fortress/prison.
40:5 each dream and shared night; 16 coarse bread; 19 execution wording. Lexical choice remains provisional.
41:14 others shave Joseph; 16 difficult negative answer; 44 hand; 45 name and Heliopolis.
42:4 sickness; 9–12 tracks; 15–16 Pharaoh’s health.
43:14 my God; 28 blessing on father; 34 fivefold portion and drunkenness.
44:1–2 plural commands; 5 my cup/my lord; 21 care promise; 30–32 dependent soul and surety.
45:7 remnant repetition; 19 command imperative and change of address number; 22–23 gifts and female mules.
46:20 extended genealogy and 26–27 stated totals sixty-six, nine and seventy-five.
47:5 repeated arrival/speech; 21 enslavement; 22 priestly land exemption; 31 staff.
48:7 difficult horse-course/Chabratha; 12 plural bowing; 16 present deliverance; 20 address number and blessing.

Running text of all 33 verse labels inspected, especially poetic images and difficult 9–10,12,21–27; repeated blessings in 28 and death in 33. This is not a completed independent syntactic or apparatus review.
50:19 belongs to God; 20 feeding; 23 thighs; 24–25 visitation and bones.

inherited_source_checks.source_variant_policy: Distinctive inherited readings retained; no alternative witness substituted silently. New English corrections and preserved uncertainties are recorded in changes.json and chapter notes.

chapters.decision: Retain seventy-five descendants, On/City of the Sun and the midwives' houses. Restore the doubled intensifier at 1:7 and 1:12: exceedingly, exceedingly strong. This is a documented correction from the inspected running text, not a new manuscript choice.
chapters.pending: The syntax of 1:19–21 and personal-name forms need independent review.

chapters.decision: Retain the basket, bitumen-pitch, Moses' water naming, Gershom alone in 2:22 and God becoming known in 2:25. Ordinary dialogue uses you/your.
chapters.pending: Review the material term in 2:3 and the Jethro/Reuel/Zipporah name index.

chapters.decision: Retain the One Who Is, repeated divine names, all seven peoples and the neighbour/fellow-lodger wording. The repeated source clauses have not been harmonized to another stream.
chapters.pending: Independent review of divine-name language and its explanation.

chapters.decision: Direct prayer retains Thee/Thou/Thy; God's speech to Moses uses you/your. Keep the angel, stone, unidentified feet and repeated blood statement in 4:24–26 without inserting a named referent.
chapters.pending: Priority review: the elliptical phrase in 4:16 and the syntax and referents of 4:24–26.

chapters.decision: Retain the feast, death or slaughter, smell and sword images. Moses' prayer at 5:22–23 retains Thou/Thy; speech to Pharaoh and the officials uses you/your.
chapters.pending: Review the legal/social vocabulary and the complaint's syntax.

chapters.decision: Retain your covenant at 6:5 (Greek plural address), Kohath's 130 years, Amram's 132 years, Jochebed's relationship, Miriam and the two named sons in 6:22.
chapters.pending: Genealogical, numerical and divine-name review.

chapters.decision: Retain a god to Pharaoh, the ages eighty/eighty-three, the singular he in 7:7, dragon in the sign and the existing distinctions in hardening vocabulary.
chapters.pending: Lexical review of dragon/serpent and the hardening verbs.

chapters.decision: Retain the appointed time, houses, finger of God, repeated Lord, dogflies and distinction wording. No insect identification has been silently substituted.
chapters.pending: Plague terminology and singular/plural address in the dialogue.

chapters.decision: Retain the repeated human/animal scope, the future threat, the passive preservation language and the strong hail description.
chapters.pending: Independent review of the tense and force of 9:15–16.

chapters.decision: Retain the south wind, sea wind, darkness/gloom/tempest and household and offering distinctions. Ordinary speech including Pharaoh's commands uses you/your.
chapters.pending: Review the rhetorical question in 10:7 and wind terminology.

chapters.decision: Retain the secret instruction, lending language, dog's tongue image and Pharaoh's servants. Smooth the departure speech without deleting its clauses.
chapters.pending: Review the lending verb and rhetorical imagery.

chapters.decision: Retain both bone prohibitions, blood beside the door, shelter language, mixed multitude, and the 430-year Egypt-and-Canaan reading. Keep slavery and resident-foreigner distinctions explicit.
chapters.pending: Passover terminology, legal status and the chronological reading require specialist review.

chapters.decision: Retain six days in 13:6 and seven in 13:7, the donkey redemption wording and the fifth generation. No harmonization of these readings.
chapters.pending: Review firstborn/redemption terms and fifth-generation wording.

chapters.decision: Retain the south wind, darkness and gloom, and bound axles. Keep lift up with your staff at 14:16 provisionally; in at 14:31 supplies an English connection while retaining the great-hand image.
chapters.pending: Priority review of the elliptical staff command in 14:16 and the construction in 14:31.

chapters.decision: The song's line breaks, repeated refrain, right-hand imagery, wrath and beyond remain. Direct address uses Thou/Thee/Thy. At 15:16 restore the second possessive: this people of Thine. At 15:13 this people of Thine retains the existing possessive in smoother English. The PDF names this chapter as a voice benchmark but does not supply an accepted full chapter text.
chapters.pending: Independent review of holy ones/holiness (15:11), comfort and dwelling (15:13), song rhythm and apparatus.

chapters.decision: Retain Man, the golden jar, Phoenicia and the measure wording. You in 16:28–29 addresses the community in the plural despite the introductory address to Moses. Keep gathering and Sabbath repetitions.
chapters.pending: Review the measure in 16:36 and food/material terms.

chapters.decision: Retain the staff, rock, place names and hidden hand. Draw up for battle makes the military command in 17:9 natural without changing its action.
chapters.pending: Priority review of the hidden-hand expression in 17:16.

chapters.decision: Retain the reported message, after the next day and the difficult pronouns in 18:11. Represent the people in matters pertaining to God at 18:19 makes the contextual role explicit in English.
chapters.pending: Review 18:11's referents, 18:13's time expression and the role phrase in 18:19.

chapters.decision: Keep royal priesthood, the departure of sounds/trumpets/cloud, the people's astonishment and the Lord departing in 19:22. Moses' direct address to God in 19:23 retains Thou; quoted commands to people use ordinary address.
chapters.pending: Review boundary language and the differing verbs in 19:22 and 19:24.

chapters.decision: Retain the Greek commandment order: adultery, theft, murder in 20:13–15. Keep saw the sound at 20:18, the repeated name in 20:24 and the original plural/singular movement; the commandments principally address a singular you, while 20:22–24 includes plural community address.
chapters.pending: Legal and literary review, including the sensory image in 20:18.

chapters.decision: Modernize conditional verbs without changing legal conditions or remedies. Retain female slaves in 21:7, the formed/unformed distinction in 21:22–23, thirty didrachmas and the theft law at 21:37.
chapters.pending: Priority legal/lexical review of 21:8–11, 17 and 22–23. No modern legal or moral application is added to Scripture.

chapters.decision: Retain the difficult pronouns and death wording in 22:2, before/through God in adjudication, taking the owner to the prey, plural sorcerers and gods/rulers at 22:27. Conditional verbs and ordinary address are made natural.
chapters.pending: Priority review of 22:2's subjects, the judicial terminology and 22:27.

chapters.decision: Keep the expanded covenant wording in 23:22, all named peoples, wine, hornets and Euphrates. You in 23:22 moves between plural community address and singular address; the repetitions are preserved. Angel pronouns remain lower case without deciding an identification.
chapters.pending: Review the expanded text against the full apparatus and confirm all singular/plural shifts.

chapters.decision: Retain seeing the place where God stood, the chosen men not missing, their appearance in God's place, the plural they said and Joshua ascending with Moses.
chapters.pending: Priority review of the vision language and the grammar in 24:10–11.

chapters.decision: Preserve blue skins, decay-resistant wood, the table of pure gold and the lampstand details. Remove the accidental duplicated from in 25:22. No verse 25:6 is inserted.
chapters.pending: Technical terms, stones, propitiatory cover and lampstand construction need specialist review.

chapters.decision: Retain north/south orientation, the singular post formulations, curtain repetitions and screening the ark with the veil. Commands to Moses use you/your; measurements are unchanged.
chapters.pending: Architectural vocabulary and the arrangement of curtains, posts and bars.

chapters.decision: Preserve the source's directions and dimensions, including fifteen/twenty cubits high and a hundred by a hundred. They have not been corrected to a familiar reconstruction.
chapters.pending: Priority architectural and textual review of directions and dimensions in 27:9–18.

chapters.decision: Retain emeralds, Manifestation and Truth, gold pomegranates, the sound, removal of sins and filling the hands. Preserve 28:29a and the absence of separate 28:23–28.
chapters.pending: Priestly dress, gemstones, oracle-piece terminology and the consecration idiom.

chapters.decision: Retain the two bread types, on the basket, the hand/foot extremities, day of purification and being called upon. At 29:30 divide the long relative construction into two linked clauses without changing the priest or the seven days.
chapters.pending: Consecration terms and the meaning of 29:43. Review the source's from-there expression at 29:42, not separately expressed in the inherited English.

chapters.decision: Retain didrachma/obols in the census and shekels in the oil recipe, iris, the repeated washing instruction and plural they shall make at 30:35.
chapters.pending: Aromatic substances and census terminology. Review the source's from-there expression in 30:6, not separately expressed in the inherited English.

chapters.decision: Retain Eliab, plural altars and ceased and rested. Preserve the inherited divine Spirit wording without treating capitalization as a resolution of theological questions.
chapters.pending: Name-index, Spirit vocabulary and Sabbath syntax.

chapters.decision: Retain wives/daughters, singular he in 32:4 and 32:6, wine-song, scattered, filled hands and the repeated forgiveness command. Direct prayer uses Thyself; human speech uses you. No separate 32:9 is inserted.
chapters.pending: Priority review of 32:18, 25, 29 and the time expression in 32:30.

chapters.decision: Retain the six peoples of 33:2, the different blow and clothing language, reveal Thyself, singular me in 33:15 and what is behind Me. Quoted divine speech inside Moses' prayer uses you; Moses addresses God as Thou/Thee/Thy.
chapters.pending: Priority review of presence, revelation and knowledge language in 33:12–23.

chapters.decision: Retain righteousness, burning carved images, both marriage directions, paying a beast's value, middle of the year and offer a lamb in milk. Keep glorified facial appearance. Thou shalt in 34:9 is retained because Moses addresses God.
chapters.pending: Covenant vocabulary, 34:22 and 26, and the glorification language.

chapters.decision: Retain I am the Lord in 35:3, the men bringing from the women, the shorter materials list, emeralds and Eliab. Preserve 35:12a and the existing absent verse labels.
chapters.pending: Offering syntax, names and material terms.

chapters.decision: Retain the Greek sequence beginning the garments at 36:8, emeralds, and the shifts between they and he. Smooth only the placement of had been given in 36:1; the other English wording already reads naturally.
chapters.pending: Technical dress vocabulary and singular/plural workmanship clauses.

chapters.decision: The English wording is retained after review. Keep a hundred by a hundred, height and breadth, Ithamar and Eliab, and this chapter's Greek arrangement.
chapters.pending: Dimensions, Levite service and craft terminology.

chapters.decision: Clarify the gold lampstand sentence while retaining the present gives light. Keep the pure-gold table, Korah censers and the repeated fasting description; do not harmonize their chronology or details.
chapters.pending: Priority review of 38:16, 18, 20, 22 and 26, including furniture terms and referents.

chapters.decision: The English wording is retained after review. Keep all quantities, drachma/shekel distinctions, gilded capitals, leftover materials and repeated statements of completion.
chapters.pending: Independent numerical and technical audit, including the silver/gilding wording in 39:5.

chapters.decision: Retain new-moon dating, poles beneath the ark, all completion repetitions and the cloud/fire conclusion. Commands use you. Keep all existing gaps in verse numbering.
chapters.pending: Review the elliptical instruction at 40:8 and the furniture/dating terms.

checks.result: Acceptability and changes of ritual agent retained. The shift from second to third person in 1:14 was not levelled.

checks.scope: 14:1–57 retrieved; selected inspection of 14:39 and the ritual sequence
checks.result: The negative in 14:39 was retained. No apparatus claim or harmonization with another textual tradition.

checks.scope: Selected inspection within 16:1–20, especially 16:8–10 and 16:14–19
checks.result: Inherited sent-away terminology and distinct ritual agents retained. This check does not settle the wider interpretive question or verify the rest of the chapter independently.

checks.scope: 19:1–37 retrieved; selected inspection of 19:18, 19:26, 19:34 and 19:36
checks.result: Neighbour and resident-stranger commands, the mountains reading and measures retained.

checks.scope: 25:1–55 retrieved; selected inspection of 25:10, 25:27–28 and 25:55
checks.result: Release language, the inherited sixth-year reading and distinctions in service terminology retained.

outstanding: Full independent Greek lexical and syntactic review
Göttingen text and critical apparatus collation
Specialist review of animal names, lesions and bodily conditions
Legal and ritual terminology, quantities, weights and measures
Independent verification of earlier reception and comparison claims

chapters.decision: Ordinary address to Joshua uses you/your. The first you in 1:5 is plural; your life and the following address are singular. In 1:6 your fathers is plural amid singular address to Joshua. The two prosperity expressions in 1:8 and the shifts between your God and our God remain.
chapters.pending: Singular/plural address, apportionment terminology and the repeated prosperity clauses.

chapters.decision: Retain the Greek speaker change to Rahab in 2:14, the phrase part of the city in 2:18, and anyone in 2:20. The spies address Rahab in the singular in 2:17–20. The yours in their life pledge at 2:14 is plural, embracing those represented by Rahab.
chapters.pending: Oath syntax, the speaker change, household relationships and the referent of part of the city.

chapters.decision: Retain the repeated ark titles, the shift from you to us in 3:10, Kiriath-jearim, water singular/plural relationships and wheat harvest. Very, very far in 3:16 restores the doubled Greek intensifier.
chapters.pending: Water imagery, geography, the doubled intensifier and the temporal comparison in 3:15.

chapters.decision: Retain ready stones, another twelve stones, and the stones before them in 4:11. The singular your son and individual address in 4:6–7 differ from the plural your sons in 4:21–22; modern you does not display every number distinction.
chapters.pending: Ready stones, the 4:11 stones clause, and singular/plural changes in the memorial instructions.

chapters.decision: Retain forty-two years, Madbaritis, new grain and the Phoenician wording. The commander is addressed as Master with ordinary you/your; the English does not decide his identity through divine pronouns. The singular sandal and plural feet in 5:15 remain.
chapters.pending: Circumcision chronology and 5:4–7 syntax; identification of the commander and the force of his title.

chapters.decision: Keep the missing 6:4 label, six circuits in 6:15 followed by the seventh circuit in 6:16, Lord Sabaoth, and the Ozan/Abiram continuation at 6:26. The he himself wording at 6:10 is retained rather than silently changed to I.
chapters.pending: Plural force of mighty in 6:2, the speaker/referent in 6:10, ban terminology and 6:26 names.

chapters.decision: Joshua directly addresses God as Thee/Thy/Thou in 7:7–9. Retain Thy servant, Achar, the differing genealogical forms, didrachms, the tongue-shaped gold bar, and the singular object him in 7:25.
chapters.pending: Prayer syntax, carpet terminology, genealogy, the bar's weight, and the relationship of 7:24–26.

chapters.decision: Keep the gaps at 8:13 and 8:26, the shorter ambush account and the forked tree. With the javelin in 8:18 supplies the English connection in the inherited hand/javelin construction; it does not select a new textual reading.
chapters.pending: The hand/javelin construction, the terrain syntax in 8:24 and the forked tree.

chapters.decision: Keep the Mount Ebal passage at 9:2a–2f. Retain the Horite and Israel's collective singular my/I in 9:7. Joshua is addressed with your, including Your servants in 9:9. Keep the slave/woodcutter wording at 9:23.
chapters.pending: The second law expression, source arrangement, collective singular address and covenant-service terms.

chapters.decision: Retain Adoni-bezek, the Jebusite kings, the missing 10:15 label and the Greek form of the sun/moon account. For a full day gives natural English to the temporal expression in 10:13. In 10:8 your hands is singular address to Joshua, while before you is plural.
chapters.pending: Names, collective subjects, the sun/moon temporal expression and the conquest summary.

chapters.decision: Smooth ordinary address while retaining the inherited names, earthworks, strengthened hearts, repeated destruction wording and the distinct whole stock of Israel phrase.
chapters.pending: Place names, earthworks, stock of Israel in 11:21 and the pronoun/reference in 11:23.

chapters.decision: Retain twenty-nine kings and the shorter list. One of the remaining giants makes the inherited description of Og easier to follow without replacing giants or changing the count.
chapters.pending: Every royal name, geographical boundary and the list's total against the apparatus.

chapters.decision: Use you/your for God's address to Joshua. Retain the five satrapies, the Great Sea boundary, repeated land grants, the source's allocations and the repeated beyond the Jordan in 13:32.
chapters.pending: Territorial names, 13:3–5 boundaries, the doubled Machir allocation at 13:31 and sentence relationships.

chapters.decision: Clarify the opening assignment sentence and Caleb's ordinary address. Keep his mind in 14:7 with its original dagger note; no antecedent is silently decided. Keep the shorter 14:2–3 construction and the repeated livestock wording in 14:4.
chapters.pending: The antecedent of his at 14:7, 14:2–4 syntax, genealogy and the mother-city expression.

chapters.decision: Modernize archaic movement verbs without renaming places. Restore future will pass/will end in the last sentence of 15:7. Preserve Golathmaim, the lettered Bethlehem-area list at 15:59a, city counts and until that day at 15:63.
chapters.pending: Full place-name and boundary collation, 15:7 fourth part, 15:17 relationship, Golathmaim and list totals.

chapters.decision: Retain the existing future boundary verbs, distinct place names and the Pharaoh/dowry continuation at 16:10. Existing English wording requires no change in this chapter.
chapters.pending: Place-name identification, border geography and the 16:10 continuation against the apparatus.

chapters.decision: Keep Anassa, Labek, the terebinth in 17:9 and choice cavalry and iron in 17:16. The sons of Joseph speak as a collective I/me at 17:14, and Joshua replies with singular address to that collective in 17:15, 17–18.
chapters.pending: Difficult geographic syntax, cavalry/iron terminology and the temporal relationship in 17:18.

chapters.decision: Smooth the surveying instruction while retaining its narrative parenthesis across 18:4–5, seven portions, and the existing boundary names and future forms.
chapters.pending: Surveying terminology, parenthetical sequence and every boundary name and direction.

chapters.decision: Retain morning until evening and no rest even a little in 2:7, affirmative I shall be in 2:13, barley meal in 2:14, and oiphi without an unsupported modern conversion in 2:17. Stay close connects the gleaning instructions in 2:8, 21 and 23. Keep eyes, heart, wings, handmaid/maidservants and the repeated mercy. The doubled be sure in 2:16 preserves the emphatic repeated construction. Lowercase he/his in 2:20 leaves the referent open. Servants in 2:21 and maidens in 2:22 are not homogenized; the past you went and future they shall not meet are retained.
chapters.pending: Independent review of the carry/cast expressions in 2:16, oiphi, the referent in 2:20 and the encounter expression in 2:22. The existing dagger note for 2:20 remains unchanged.

chapters.decision: Keep rest, heart, strength, the wing image and repeated next-of-kin language. Preserve go up in 3:3 and went down in 3:6, the drinking/eating order, and what is at his feet without specifying a body part or adding an action to 3:7. The sentence in 3:11 continues into 3:12 with and that. Six measures in 3:15 and 17 does not specify an unstated unit. The inherited he entered the city in 3:15 remains an interpretive choice; the Greek verb does not itself supply a gendered pronoun. Keep Who are you? in 3:16 and the difficult negative matter shall not fall through in 3:18.
chapters.pending: Independent review of the feet expression, the 3:11–12 construction, the subject of entered in 3:15, the question in 3:16 and the negative idiom in 3:18. Both existing dagger notes remain unchanged.

chapters.decision: Preserve unnamed one, the field given to Naomi rather than a harmonized sale, uncover your ear, repeated kinship rights, hand, inheritance, seed and raising up the dead man's name. chapters.pending: Independent review of the legal constructions in 4:3–7, the plural clause and name expression in 4:11, and the verbal subject and your name in 4:14. Both existing dagger notes remain unchanged.
